gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Wallpoet cuts its lowercase tall and lets the paper show through a line running between letters. And Noto Sans Bengali follows in a plain sans, with open mouths and capitals barely above the lowercase, so long paragraphs would read smoothly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Loud, stenciled, built to be noticed. But where Wallpoet is all swagger in its high lowercase, Noto Sans Bhaiksuki is the plain sans that stays readable, with swollen, tightly coiled letters and open apertures.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Commanding from the first letter, Wallpoet sweeps smoothly around every bend and lets the paper peek through a line between its letters. Noto Sans Brahmi gives it a sturdy partner.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid is modern and restrained. Beside Wallpoet's high lowercase and see-through line, it offers generous space between curve ends and stems, so a long passage in this sans would move along comfortably.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-carian: Bold, mostly. Wallpoet carries a smooth path around every bend and a line of paper showing through, while Noto Sans Carian sits beneath it as a sans with terminals that stay apart like open scissor blades.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Wallpoet comes in commanding, its lowercase rising high with a line of paper showing between the letters. Yet Noto Sans Chakma is the plain sans that tempers it, packing its lowercase close to the caps with uncrowded mouths.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-cham: Big, loud, and stenciled: Wallpoet runs smooth around each bend with a high lowercase. Noto Sans Cham brings the pair's strongest quality, a modern sans-serif with open c shapes and tall rounded forms.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee forms a tall band of letters with short stalks above and an e with a wide gap at its terminal. Give that sans-serif the larger size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian reads large and open, with short ascenders. Wallpoet is best at commanding attention with its smooth bends and see-through line, while this sans-serif is best at letting curves stop short and stay legible.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Heavy-hitting and bold, Wallpoet pairs smooth curves with a high lowercase and a line where the paper shows through. But Noto Sans Coptic is the pair's best quality, a clean sans-serif whose middle zone dominates each line.
